purpose: E2 check: reach trials (method §2.1.1 step 1) from every checkpoint of the checkpointed stage-0 rerun. The reference is the same K_v1 stage code (user decision 2026-11-15, option A), so on K_v1 episodes a trial is a replay: it checks the mechanism and the record format, not the reference's reliability. Calibration of the false-unreachable rate needs non-reference executors and is registered with E4.
budget_note: One trial per checkpoint with a next node; about 69 expected from the stage-0 failure stages. Trials are evaluator-side episodes, counted here and in no column's success.
prediction: Every trial's tool boundary row equals the source episode's row for that tool (recoverable excluded); reachable is true exactly where the source passed that tool's boundary check.
Every attribution is untestable (reference is the failed executor), so attributed_p equals raw_p at every node.
falsification: Any trial differing from its source boundary, or a trial without its own boundary row: the stop/resume path is wrong; E2 is not done.
Any attribution other than untestable on these K_v1 episodes.
not_tested: Whether K_v1 is a trustworthy reference for a node (false-unreachable rate). That needs entries a non-K_v1 executor passed, available from E4.
